div.div:
• HTTPS with managed certificates
• Strict transport security (HSTS)
• Allowed origins only (CORS)
• Rate limit per client
• Upload size limit

div.div:
• Every request: signed token checked
against the sign in service keys
• Session still active (checked every 30 s)
• Permission check on every action
• Login cookie: HttpOnly, Secure
• Apps reachable only from the gateway

div.div:
• PostgreSQL: SSL required, firewall
allows Azure services only
• Storage: no public access,
shared keys off, private container
• Backend may write only its own
container (managed identity role)
